Do not give dogs what is holy; do not throw your pearls before swine. If you do, they may trample them under their feet, and then turn and tear you to pieces.
Therefore, the prudent keep silent in such times, for the days are evil.
Do not answer a fool according to his folly, or you yourself will be like him.
But like a deaf man, I do not hear; and like a mute man, I do not open my mouth.

verses.text: Then Hilkiah’s son Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the scribe, and Asaph’s son Joah the recorder came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and they relayed to him the words of the Rabshakeh.

xrefs.text: Yet in hearing all these words, the king and his servants did not become frightened or tear their garments.
When Reuben returned to the pit and saw that Joseph was not there, he tore his clothes,
Then Job stood up, tore his robe, and shaved his head. He fell to the ground and worshiped,
When the king heard the words of the woman, he tore his clothes. And as he passed by on the wall, the people saw the sackcloth under his clothes next to his skin.
At this, the high priest tore his clothes and declared, “He has blasphemed! Why do we need any more witnesses? Look, now you have heard the blasphemy.
